versions.localizedDescription:
### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
> [!NOTE]
> - 📺Full 4KHDR support.
> - 📦Downloads working partially. depending on hardware codecs. 
> - 🫧 Liquid Glass and iPhone Duo support.
> - 🆕 `YTLowContrastMode` tweak, enabled by default.
> 
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTweaks` `YouSpeed` `YouMute` `YouLoop` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTLowContrastMode` 
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)`

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
